Based on the conversation history, specifically Step 3 in [Source: STAGE 1 _ TOKENIZER.pdf | Score: 0.331], the Self-Attention Mechanism is described as:

"Attention = softmax(QKᵀ / √dk)"

This formula calculates the attention weights between different tokens in a sequence. The self-attention mechanism allows the model to weigh the importance of each token relative to every other token, enabling it to capture complex relationships and dependencies within the input sequence.

In simpler terms, the Self-Attention Mechanism is a way for the model to focus on specific parts of the input when generating output, rather than treating all tokens equally.
